title: Why Companies Are Firing Managers and Hiring AI
full_monologue: **Every company is firing managers and hiring AI**—and here’s why. AI is faster, cheaper, and doesn’t need a coffee break. It handles data, automates tasks, and makes decisions with precision. But humans? They’re slow, error-prone, and expensive. Companies are realizing that AI can do the job better. And it’s not just about efficiency—it’s about staying competitive. The future belongs to the companies that embrace AI. So, what do you think? Are humans replaceable, or is there still a place for us?
